figureAlts.figure22.gif: A tortoise and a hare want to have a race on a number line. They both start at 0 and the race lasts for 100 time steps. However, they move differently. At each time step, the tortoise moves 1 step forward with a 1/2 chance and stays in place with a 1/2 chance, while the hare moves 3 steps forward with a 1/6 chance. They race, and the tortoise loses badly; the hare finishes 50 steps ahead of the tortoise. Suspicious, the tortoise decides to conduct a hypothesis test to determine whether or not the hare is actually faster.
